nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel wiring the messages submodules: builders, cleanup, insert_tests, and load_llm.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Core message persistence layer: row models (AgentMessageRow, AgentSessionStatus, AgentResponse) plus insert-with-retry, load, and cascading-delete helpers built on a blocking-task wrapper for rusqlite.

nodes.name: AgentMessageRow
nodes.summary: Database row model for a single persisted agent conversation message, including role, content, tool metadata, and compaction bookkeeping fields.

nodes.name: AgentSessionStatus
nodes.summary: Enum of an agent session's lifecycle status with parsing/display helpers and a terminal-state check.

nodes.name: AgentResponse
nodes.summary: Simple response DTO carrying an agent's generated content, session id, and model used.

nodes.name: spawn_blocking_cmd
nodes.summary: Runs a blocking (synchronous rusqlite) closure on tokio's blocking thread pool and awaits its result.

nodes.name: collect_session_image_paths
nodes.summary: Collects the on-disk file paths of all images referenced by a session's messages, for later cleanup.

nodes.name: delete_session_cascade
nodes.summary: Deletes a session's rows across a given set of tables in a single cascading operation.

nodes.name: insert_message
nodes.summary: Inserts a message row, computing its sequence number, within a table identified by prefix.

nodes.name: insert_message_retry
nodes.summary: Inserts a message row with retry-on-busy handling for concurrent SQLite writers.

nodes.name: load_messages
nodes.summary: Loads all message rows for a session ordered by sequence.

nodes.name: todos.rs
nodes.summary: Persists a session's todo list (TodoRecord items) as JSON, with save/get/patch-update operations.

nodes.name: TodoRecord
nodes.summary: Persisted representation of a single todo item within a session's task list.

nodes.name: TodoUpdate
nodes.summary: Partial-update DTO for patching fields of an existing todo item.

nodes.name: save_todos
nodes.summary: Persists a session's full todo list as JSON, replacing any prior list.

nodes.name: get_todos
nodes.summary: Loads a session's persisted todo list, deserializing it from JSON.

nodes.name: update_todo
nodes.summary: Applies a partial patch to a single todo item at a given position in a session's list.

nodes.name: images.rs
nodes.summary: Parses data-URL images, persists them to disk under content-addressed (sha256) filenames, and reloads/deletes them, backing message image attachments.

nodes.name: DataUrl
nodes.summary: Parsed representation of a data: URL split into its media type and base64 payload.

nodes.name: parse_data_url
nodes.summary: Parses a data:<mime>;base64,<payload> string into a DataUrl struct.

nodes.name: persist_images
nodes.summary: Decodes a list of base64 data-url images and writes them to disk under content-addressed (sha256) filenames, returning stored image references.

nodes.name: load_image_as_data_url
nodes.summary: Reads an image file from disk and re-encodes it as a base64 data URL.

nodes.name: delete_image_files
nodes.summary: Deletes a list of image files from disk, best-effort.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel wiring the persistence submodules: db_helpers, images, session_snapshots, and test_schema.

nodes.name: session_snapshots.rs
nodes.summary: Manages per-session file-change snapshots: schema migration, CRUD for snapshot rows, workspace-path discovery, and computing the set of files a session modified by scanning and parsing tool-call rows (edit/write/patch tools).

nodes.name: SessionFileChange
nodes.summary: Aggregated record of how many times a tool modified a given file path within a session, used to compute the session's modified-files summary.

nodes.name: try_drop_column
nodes.summary: Attempts to drop a column from a table during schema migration, tolerating SQLite versions/backends that don't support it.

nodes.name: ensure_tables_with
nodes.summary: Creates (or migrates) all session-snapshot related tables and indexes on the given connection.

nodes.name: get_snapshots
nodes.summary: Retrieves all file-change snapshots recorded for a session.

nodes.name: truncate_snapshots_after
nodes.summary: Deletes snapshots created after a given timestamp, used when rewinding a session.

nodes.name: get_snapshots_after
nodes.summary: Retrieves snapshots created after a given timestamp.

nodes.name: get_latest_snapshot_before_by_tool_call_id
nodes.summary: Finds the most recent snapshot before a given timestamp associated with a specific tool call.

nodes.name: get_snapshot_created_at_by_hash
nodes.summary: Looks up the creation timestamp of a snapshot by its content hash.

nodes.name: clear_review_snapshots
nodes.summary: Deletes snapshots that were only created for code-review purposes.

nodes.name: get_oldest_snapshot_ids
nodes.summary: Retrieves the ids of the oldest snapshots for a session, used for pruning.

nodes.name: delete_snapshots_by_ids
nodes.summary: Deletes a specific set of snapshots by id.

nodes.name: get_snapshot_ids_by_tool_call_id
nodes.summary: Retrieves snapshot ids associated with a given tool call.

nodes.name: delete_all_snapshots_for_session
nodes.summary: Deletes every snapshot recorded for a session.

nodes.name: get_latest_snapshot_by_tool_call_prefix
nodes.summary: Finds the latest snapshot whose tool_call_id starts with a given prefix, supporting sub-call snapshot lookups.

nodes.name: get_session_workspace_path
nodes.summary: Retrieves the filesystem workspace path associated with a session.

nodes.name: list_known_workspace_paths
nodes.summary: Lists distinct known workspace paths across recent sessions.

nodes.name: save_file_resolution
nodes.summary: Persists a user's resolution decision (e.g. accept/reject) for a reviewed file within a session.

nodes.name: get_file_resolutions
nodes.summary: Retrieves all file-review resolutions recorded for a session.

nodes.name: clear_file_resolutions
nodes.summary: Clears all file-review resolutions for a session.

nodes.name: column_exists
nodes.summary: Checks whether a given column exists on a table, used to guard idempotent migrations.

nodes.name: query_session_file_tool_rows
nodes.summary: Generic query helper selecting tool-call rows matching given tool names for a session, used by the modified-files scanners.

nodes.name: accumulate_session_file_change
nodes.summary: Extracts file paths touched by a single tool call and accumulates per-file change counts into a running map.

nodes.name: get_session_modified_files_since
nodes.summary: Scans a session's tool-call history since a given time and computes the set of files modified with per-file edit counts.

nodes.name: extract_paths_from_patch_text
nodes.summary: Extracts file paths referenced in a unified-diff patch's header lines.

nodes.name: extract_paths_from_tool_input
nodes.summary: Extracts the file path(s) a given tool call's input JSON is operating on, dispatching by tool name.

nodes.name: test_schema.rs
nodes.summary: Creates the full set of agent-session related tables on a fresh (typically in-memory) SQLite connection, mirroring the production schema for use in unit tests.

nodes.name: ensure_agent_sessions_schema
nodes.summary: Creates the full set of agent-session related tables on a fresh (typically in-memory) SQLite connection, mirroring production schema for use in unit tests.
